marks.gloss_en: אמאי? הא לא בלע כלל! -- if he stirred from start to end, the piece absorbed nothing
stam: by implication R' Yehuda holds that where he stirred from start to end and covered from start to end -- forbidden
אימא: לא ניער יפה יפה, ולא כסה יפה יפה -- say: he did not stir thoroughly and did not cover thoroughly
ממאי דבאפשר לסוחטו פליגי? דלמא אפשר לסוחטו דברי הכל אסור, והכא במין במינו קא מיפלגי -- R' Yehuda: a type in its type is not nullified; the Rabbis: it is nullified

האי מאי? if the Rabbis here agree with R' Yehuda on a type in its type and they dispute efshar lesochato, that is why Rebbi said 'R' Yehuda's words appear in this, Chachamim's in that'; but if all agree efshar lesochato is forbidden and they dispute a type in its type, he should have said 'R' Yehuda's words appear and do not appear' (109a.8). Steinsaltz gives this reply to Ravina; the text names no speaker.
האמרת נראין דברי רבי יהודה בהא! -- that case was already assigned to R' Yehuda's words
reading: he stirred at the end and not at first, and covered at the end and not at first
stam: by implication the Rabbis hold that where he stirred at the end and not at first, covered at the end and not at first -- permitted
the udder -- he tears it and removes its milk
